args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, FIN-212)
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed on `tests/test_money.py`, which expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212. However, `src/money.py` implemented ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring claiming banker's rounding.

## Changes
- `round_money` in `src/money.py` now uses `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`, matching the documented behavior.

## Validation
- CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` passed.

Reviewer: @alex

trace.final:
